name: @caistech/dataroom-core
description: Tier-gated RAG-over-documents engine (extracted from the LingoPure investor dataroom): ingest → embed → tier-filtered retrieve → cited answer / multi-section report → branded, watermarked PDF. App-agnostic — the LLM (chat) and the DB (retrieve) are injected, so the package never touches a DB or pins a model SDK; the tier filter stays inside the consumer's SECURITY DEFINER RPC. v0.1.0 = the runtime engine (retrieve/answer/report/pdf/tier); the Node-only ingest pipeline is a planned /ingest subpath.
